description: Today kernels are compiled ahead of time with cc -O3 at mix compile. A Rustler NIF embedding Cranelift could JIT kernels at runtime (Livebook, value-specialised kernels, no C toolchain needed on the target). Measure code quality vs the LLVM path on the demo kernels.

comments.text: Per 'Is a C compiler at build time acceptable for a defk library?' (defk-dtw.11): not the named way out of the C-toolchain requirement (that is precompiled artefacts); stays an exploration listed under 'Where defk could grow'.

title: Explore Cranelift JIT backend for runtime-specialised kernels
